description: As part of Intuitive's mission, it believes that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care, and by combining ingenuity and intelligent technology it expands the potential of physicians to heal without constraints, envisioning a future of care that is less invasive and more highly effective, through products including the da Vinci surgical system and the Ion endoluminal system, and the Company, Intuitive Surgical, Inc., is incorporated in Delaware and refers to itself and its wholly and majority-owned subsidiaries, with product and brand names including Intuitive, da Vinci and Ion being trademarks or registered trademarks of Intuitive Surgical, Inc. or one of its subsidiaries.
